description_en: Updates the complete rule list of an existing policy for the current account. For IP_RANGE policies, the client IP address ranges can be replaced as a whole at the same time. If ClientIpRanges is omitted, the original IP address ranges are retained. Explicitly passing an empty array is not allowed. The update does not change the bound domain names, match types, or enabled status of the policy. The new ranges are checked for conflicts only with other IP address range policies under the same domain name. If the validation fails, the update is not saved. After a successful update, you can call SdnsGetRuleCategory to verify the configuration. Actual DNS resolution requires waiting for configuration propagation
description_zh: 更新当前账号已有策略的完整规则列表。对于 IP_RANGE 策略，可同时整体替换客户端地址段；省略 ClientIpRanges 时保留原地址段，显式传入空数组不允许。更新不改变策略的绑定域名、匹配类型和启停状态。新范围仅与同域名的其他地址段策略检查冲突；校验失败不保存本次更新。成功后可调用 SdnsGetRuleCategory 核对配置，实际解析需等待配置传播
name: UpdateSdnsRuleCategory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the policy for the current account. This parameter is required. You can obtain the ID from the Id field in the response of CreateSdnsRuleCategory or from the list returned by SdnsListRuleCategories. Use a decimal string to avoid precision loss for large integers
parameters.help_zh: 当前账号的策略 Id，必须提供。可从 CreateSdnsRuleCategory 的 Id 或 SdnsListRuleCategories 的列表中获取；使用十进制字符串，避免大整数精度丢失
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The JSON text string of the IP address range array. This parameter is used only to update IP_RANGE policies. If this parameter is omitted, the original IP address ranges are retained. If this parameter is provided, the original IP address ranges are replaced as a whole. You cannot pass an empty string, an empty array [], null, or a non-string array. Single IP addresses, CIDR blocks, and start-end ranges of IPv4 and IPv6 are supported. Multiple entries have an OR relationship. For CIDR blocks, the IPv4 prefix length ranges from 0 to 32, and the IPv6 prefix length ranges from 0 to 128. Start-end ranges are inclusive and must belong to the same address family, and the start address must not be greater than the end address. Overlapping, containing, and duplicate ranges are allowed within the same policy. When the policy is saved and read back, the array order, duplicate items, and the original text of each string are retained. An array can contain up to 2,000 array elements. The total number of parsed non-empty address expressions ranges from 1 to 2,000, and duplicate items are counted. We recommend that you specify one expression per element. It is compatible with line breaks within an element. Each expression can contain up to 128 characters, including leading and trailing whitespace. The serialized UTF-8 JSON sequence cannot exceed 65,535 bytes. The quantity and byte limits take effect at the same time. Overlapping is not allowed among different IP_RANGE policies of the same account, the same domain name, and the same address family. Disabled policies are also checked. Disabling a policy does not release its IP address ranges. This limit does not compare LINE policies and the independent configurations of the legacy SetIPRegionResult operation. The new ranges do not conflict with the old ranges of the same policy during an update. Send this parameter as a single form field, and do not add quotes to the JSON text again
parameters.help_zh: 地址段数组的 JSON 文本字符串，仅用于更新 IP_RANGE 策略。省略参数保留原地址段；提供时整体替换，不能传空字符串、空数组 []、null 或非字符串数组。支持 IPv4 和 IPv6 的单 IP、CIDR 或起止范围，多个条目之间为或关系。CIDR 的 IPv4 前缀为 0～32、IPv6 为 0～128；起止范围包含两端，必须属于同一地址族且起点不大于终点。同一策略内允许重复、包含和交叉，保存并回读时保留数组顺序、重复项及每个字符串的原文。数组元素最多 2000 个，解析后的非空地址表达式总数为 1～2000，重复项也计数。建议一个元素填写一条表达式；兼容元素内换行，每条表达式最多 128 个字符（含首尾空白）。序列化后的 UTF-8 JSON 内容不得超过 65535 字节，数量和字节限制同时生效。同一账号、同一域名、同一地址族的不同 IP_RANGE 策略之间不允许重叠，其他停用策略也参与检查；停用不会释放范围。此限制不比较 LINE 策略和老接口 SetIPRegionResult 的独立配置。更新时不与自身旧范围冲突。作为单个表单字段发送，不要再次给 JSON 文本加引号
parameters.name: client_ip_ranges

fields.help_en: The optional list of custom parameter names, which is used to record the display order. Omit this parameter if you match only by IP address range. If you use Args, the names must correspond to the parameter names in Args
fields.help_zh: 可选的自定义参数名称列表，用于记录展示顺序。仅按地址段匹配时省略；使用 Args 时应与其中的参数名称对应
fields.name: arg_keys

fields.help_en: The optional custom parameter conditions. The key is the parameter name, and the value is the match value. Omit this parameter if you match only by IP address range. You do not need to add business parameters
fields.help_zh: 可选的自定义参数条件，键为参数名，值为匹配值。仅按地址段匹配时省略，不需要添加业务参数
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The name of the rule. This parameter is required and cannot be null. We recommend that you use a non-empty name that has business meaning. The name cannot replace the policy ID
fields.help_zh: 规则名称，必须提供，不能为 null。建议使用非空且有业务含义的名称；不能替代策略 Id
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The single destination IP address corresponding to the record. When Type is set to 1, the IP address is an IPv4 address, such as 192.0.2.200. When Type is set to 28, the IP address is an IPv6 address, such as 2001:db8::200. Do not use CIDR blocks, start-end ranges, or domain names
fields.help_zh: 记录对应的单个目标 IP。Type=1 时为 IPv4，例如 192.0.2.200；Type=28 时为 IPv6，例如 2001:db8::200。不使用 CIDR、起止范围或域名
fields.name: ip

fields.help_en:
The DNS record type. Valid values:
1: A record.
28: AAAA record.
Specify an integer. Do not use the string A or AAAA
fields.help_zh: DNS 记录类型：1 表示 A 记录，28 表示 AAAA 记录。填写整数，不使用字符串 A 或 AAAA
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The auxiliary display text for the record type. This text is not used for matching or DNS resolution decisions. You can omit this parameter in the request
fields.help_zh: 记录类型的展示辅助文本，不参与匹配或解析决策；请求中可以省略
fields.name: type_label

fields.help_en: The relative weight of the record. This parameter is used to select one record of the same queried type only when ResultMode is set to 1. We recommend that you set this parameter to a positive integer from 1 to 100. The sum of the weights of all records does not need to be 100. This parameter is not used for selection when ResultMode is set to 0
fields.help_zh: 记录的相对权重，仅在 ResultMode=1 时用于选择同一查询类型的一条记录。建议设置 1～100 的正整数，各记录权重之和不必为 100；ResultMode=0 时不参与选择
fields.name: weight

fields.help_en: The list of configured DNS records. The list can include A and AAAA records. Actual DNS resolution returns only the records of the queried type. If the list is empty or does not contain records of the queried type, the system continues to fall back
fields.help_zh: 配置的解析记录列表，可包含 A 和 AAAA。实际解析仅返回所查询类型的记录；列表为空或没有当前查询类型的记录时继续回退
fields.name: records

fields.help_en:
The record return mode. Valid values:
0: Returns all records of the queried type.
1: Returns one record of the queried type based on the weight
fields.help_zh: 记录返回方式：0 表示返回所查询类型的全部记录，1 表示按权重返回所查询类型的一条记录
fields.name: result_mode

fields.help_en: The cache validity period of the record, in seconds. The value must be a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 记录的缓存有效期，单位为秒，必须为正整数
fields.name: ttl

parameters.help_en: The complete list of rules. This parameter is required and must contain at least one rule. If you match only by IP address range, you can configure a default rule without ArgKeys and Args, and configure the A or AAAA destination addresses in the Records field of the rule. The update replaces the original rule list as a whole. Old rules that are not included in the new list are removed. When the rules are saved, the serialized UTF-8 JSON content must be less than 65,535 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 必须提供的完整规则列表，至少一条。仅按地址段匹配时配置一条不带 ArgKeys 和 Args 的默认规则即可，并在该规则的 Records 中配置 A/AAAA 目标地址。更新会整体替换原规则列表，未包含的旧规则会被移除。保存时序列化后的 UTF-8 JSON 内容必须小于 65535 字节
parameters.name: rules

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot call issues. This ID is not the policy ID
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，用于排查调用问题，不是策略 Id
